source.name: openssl-source
source.sha256Provenance: published by OpenSSL next to the tarball (.sha256) and PGP signed (fingerprint B146 647E 45A7 B339 47AB 226B 2A2C 87D1 6169 2D40 per openssl-library.org/source, re-verify)

configureNotes: No --enable-gpl and no external GPL codecs (x264/x265): H.264 comes from VideoToolbox, AAC from FFmpeg's native encoder. With OpenSSL 3 (Apache-2.0) FFmpeg requires --enable-version3, so the resulting license is LGPL v3 or later.
No DeckLink flags and no --enable-nonfree: capture is the separate native/decklink-capture helper (ADR 2026-10-13).
The protocol line is a candidate narrowing; the capability probe is the gate. Remove it if configure rejects it, the probe decides.

--disable-autodetect keeps Homebrew/MacPorts libraries out of the build; AudioToolbox/CoreFoundation etc. are system frameworks and need no flag. OpenSSL is built first, static, into a private prefix.
